goal: Decide source/value boundaries for Universaarl Gen. Business Posting Groups before any Master Data or setup write gate.
whyNow: Gen. Business Posting Groups are observed as context in older Foundation evidence but remain not write-ready; the blocked customer setup route recovery must not be repeated without a materially new hypothesis.
businessPurpose: Separate training context from setup correctness and prepare a realistic customer-project path for posting-group dependent master data.
expectedOutput: A compact local result JSON classifying Gen. Business Posting Group candidates as accepted-context, source-needed, blocked or parked.
A nextCase selection that does not repeat CUSTOMER-SETUP-ROUTE-RECOVERY-READFIRST without a materially new hypothesis.
Explicit boundary that no setup, master data, document, Preview Posting or Posting change was made.
stopConditions: Stop if the decision requires opening Business Central or running Playwright live.
Stop if the output would create or edit Business Central data.
Stop if the output would claim setup, Master Data or process readiness.
Stop if no source/evidence basis exists for naming candidate values; park and select a source-check case instead.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use only if the source decision names a precise missing UI proof and a materially new route.
Use only if the source decision can safely park or classify the dependency without setup correctness claims.
Use if broader posting-group/VAT source gaps must be re-opened locally.
